实例ID。
> 参数ResourceId与Tag需要至少填写一项。
description.en: The ID of instance N. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.
The resource type. Set the value to instance.

description.zh:
标签列表。
> 参数ResourceId与Tag需要至少填写一项。
description.en:
The tags that are added to instances.

>  You must specify at least one of the ResourceId and Tag parameters.

description.zh:
标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。

`Tag.N`用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例，由一个键值对组成。

N的取值范围：1~20

- 仅指定`Tag.N.Key`时，则返回关联该标签键的所有实例。
- 仅指定`Tag.N.Value`，则报错`InvalidParameter.TagValue`。
- 同时指定多个标签键值对时，仅同时满足所有标签键值对的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例会被查找到。
description.en:
The key of tag N. The key must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

You can use `Tag.N` to query AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances that have specific tags added. Tag.N consists of Tag.N.Key and Tag.N.Value.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

*   If you specify only `Tag.N.Key`, all instances that have the tag key added are returned.
*   If you specify only `Tag.N.Value`, the `InvalidParameter.TagValue` error message is returned.
*   If you specify multiple tag key-value pairs at a time, the instances that match all the specified tag key-value pairs are returned.

description.zh:
标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~128。

N的取值范围：1~20
description.en:
The value of tag N. The value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --resource-id gp-2zev51nt170740000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'gp-2zev51nt170740000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType instance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
